subject: Novacentral questionnaire sync & artifact workshop — escalation plan
messages:
From: Alex Bishop <alex.bishop@novacentral.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@novacentral.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T09:06:00-07:00
Subject: Novacentral CAIQ + SOC2 pack — request to schedule sync

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking this on. We attached our most recent CAIQ (Novacentral_CAIQ_v2.xlsx) and a short control-priority list for the audit team. Procurement is on a tight timeline and asked that we complete the questionnaire review and an evidence mapping workshop next week.

Request: 60-minute call to walk the CAIQ items, map artifact owners, and confirm log/sample windows. We also need to understand Redwood's escalation path if we surface any control gaps.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue May 2, 15:00–16:00
- Wed May 3, 11:00–12:00

Attendees on our side: Lisa Chang (Procurement), Jason Lee (Security Engineer), and myself.

One ask: procurement needs recording consent documented for vendor audits — are you able to keep a short recording and share the transcript?

Attachments: Novacentral_CAIQ_v2.xlsx; control-priority.pdf (inline).

Thanks,
Alex Bishop
Head of IT Security — Novacentral
alex.bishop@novacentral.com
security@novacentral.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Bishop <alex.bishop@novacentral.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novacentral CAIQ + SOC2 pack — request to schedule sync

Hi Alex — thanks for sending the CAIQ and the priority list. Happy to run the 60-minute workshop. May 2 at 15:00 PT works for our team; I penciled it in and created a tentative Meet link. I'll share the confirmed invite once we lock attendees.

Suggested agenda (45–60 min):
1) Quick context (5 min) — scope, timeline, and procurement constraints
2) Artifact mapping (20–25 min) — map CAIQ controls to customer-supplied artifacts and Redwood artifacts
3) Evidence owners & delivery plan (10–15 min) — who delivers what, when
4) Escalation & remediation flow (10 min) — how we handle discovered gaps and timeline to closure

Pre-work from Novacentral: please flag top 10 controls you want prioritized and confirm who on your side will own pulling log samples. If you can drop those names into the shared OneDrive folder that would help us route owners quickly.

We will bring: redwood_intake_template.xlsx (artifact mapping template), a short runbook for log-sample extraction, and a playbook for remediation escalations.

Attachments (for prep): redwood_intake_template.xlsx (artifact mapping).

Recording consent: we can record the session and share the transcript. We'll keep the recording within Redwood's secure sharing and mark it as retrospective evidence for the intake. If your procurement needs a specific consent line, please send it and we'll include it in the calendar invite.

Evelyn Hart
Customer Security Manager | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Bishop <alex.bishop@novacentral.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novacentral CAIQ + SOC2 pack — request to schedule sync

Alex / team — quick notes from our side to make the workshop efficient:

- We'll use the intake template to capture per-control artifact owners. I'll own consolidating answers post-call.
- For log samples we need:
  * service name, timeframe (UTC), and sample extraction query (if available)
  * file format preference: CSV preferred; if large, S3/OneDrive link is fine
- Typical artifacts we ask customers to have ready (examples): access provisioning screenshots, IAM policy exports, config snapshots, firewall rule exports, and two weeks of application logs for selected services.

Pre-call ask for Novacentral: drop a single CSV with the control mapping suggested owners (columns: control_id, suggested_owner_name, suggested_owner_email). I attached a small starter file (artifact-roster.csv) you can reuse.

I'll be on the workshop and will cover evidence timelines and handoff cadence. David will cover log sample requirements and retention alignment.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Bishop <alex.bishop@novacentral.com>

Subject: Re: Novacentral CAIQ + SOC2 pack — request to schedule sync

Thanks — May 2 at 15:00 PT is confirmed on our side. Attendees: Alex Bishop, Lisa Chang (procurement), Jason Lee (security).

I've uploaded our control-priority list and the owner table to the OneDrive link: https://1drv.ms/u/s!Novacentral/QuestionnaireFolder. Jason will try to provide the first-pass log extraction query ahead of the call.

We consent to the recording for procurement purposes. A 10–15 minute tech-check 15 minutes before the workshop would be helpful to verify access to any consoles we need to show. Please add the tech-check to the calendar invite if possible.

Also linking our procurement ticket: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/4758 — procurement asked that we capture the remediation SLA in writing in the next two weeks.

Looking forward to the workshop.

—Alex
